name: Darren
source:
Darren is essentially a playboy character who likes to make inappropriate remarks to Runa and essentially perving on her. He is very soft-spoken and appears very nice but actually has a very jealous side to him too. He gets bossed around by Gerald quite a bit because he can never be bothered to work. He likes flowers.

(from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/07/10/kago-no-naka-no-alicis-review/]Liemyx's Eroge Blog[/url])
